name: dev-flow
description: Drives a dev workflow end-to-end (feats or fixes) in 4 phases — plan, build, verify, ship: brainstorm → spec → plan → create GitHub issue → execute (TDD) → test → review → doc-fix → open PR → manual merge → close-out. Own execute-tasks, test, review, doc-fix, open-pr, create-github-issue, commit, and new-idea skills plus /new-feature and /new-idea commands. Depends on superpowers for brainstorming, writing-plans, and test-driven-development.
